messages:
incbot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - elevated 5xx rate on streaming endpoints (/v1/stream). Alert from prod-edge metrics. Detecting increased timeout/reconnects across us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Spike started ~11:02 UTC.

maya (oncall): acked. paging dmitri. I'm on call, collecting customer impact.

dmitri (sre): on it. looking at grafana - error rate 5xx up 12x for stream routes, latency tail rising. Errors mostly 502/504 and 'stream write timeout'.

carla (eng-runtime): fyi, last deploy to edge-streamer yesterday included chunked transfer rework. Could be related.

dmitri (sre): traces are sparse for these requests - most have no span ids. sampling looks low for streaming. suspect proxy isn't propagating request ids into backend.

maya (oncall): customer impact? any major tenants complaining?

lee (support): got two customer tickets about dropped streams and reconnect loops from realtime-speech. Marking high.

carla (eng-runtime): quick check: envoy config v2 removed `x-request-id` forwarding for streaming for a size fix. Suggest hotpatch to copy `x-request-id` header in stream proxy layer.

sam (infra): I can roll a config change to edge-streamer canary. propose adding this small snippet in envoy filter:

```yaml
http_filters:
  - name: envoy.filters.http.router
    typed_config: {}
  - name: local.header_copy
    config:
      copy_headers: ["x-request-id"]
```

dmitri (sre): also add temporary debug logs for stream lifecycle: log `x-request-id`, backend-status, and last-chunk-timestamp. We'll count missing ids.

carla (eng-runtime): quick curl test to reproduce (from bastion):

```bash
curl -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "X-Request-Id: test-123" -N "https://edge.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=stream-bert-v2" | head -n 5
```

maya (oncall): trying the curl now.

maya (oncall): no x-request-id seen in backend logs. confirmed.

dmitri (sre): ok plan:
- sam will roll envoy filter canary to 5% in us-east-1
- carla will add light-weight logs + a prometheus counter `edge_stream_missing_reqid_total` and expose to grafana
- if canary reduces 5xx, promote
- if not, route stream traffic to `stream-bert-legacy` fallback and enable frontend rate-limit

sam (infra): starting canary now. will post deploy id.

monitor-bot: Deploy started: deploy/edge-streamer-config-canary id=deploy-8821 by sam. :gear:

sam (infra): canary live at 5% in us-east-1. monitor.

dmitri (sre): adding prom counter metric via pushgateway: push job=edge_stream_probe value=1 label=missing_reqid

carla (eng-runtime): pushed logs and counter. snippet added to /opt/edge/logging/stream_shim

maya (oncall): watching grafana panels. tailing logs.

maya (oncall): after canary, 5xx rate in canary subset dropped ~70%. overall cluster still elevated but trending down.

dmitri (sre): good signal. promote to 50% and enable fallback routing for high-latency connections.

sam (infra): promoted to 50% US. starting eu canary.

lee (support): prepping customer note draft: short blurb + mitigation steps + ETA.

maya (oncall): remediation checklist:
- confirm logs have request ids for 99% of streaming requests
- validate reduced 5xx and tail latency
- remove debug logs after 48h
- postmortem if >1h customer impact

carla (eng-runtime): once stable, we'll backport fix to envoy upstream and prepare permanent release.

maya (oncall): big thanks. reactions: :thumbsup: :eyes:

sam (infra): canary id deploy-8821 promoted to 100% us-east-1. eu in progress.

monitor-bot: Alert resolved for stream endpoints in us-east-1. :white_check_mark: 

maya (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. will leave monitoring for 2 hours then close if stable.

lee (support): customer note sent to affected tenants.

maya (oncall): postmortem owner: carla. timeline will include missing header regression, deploy, canary results, and action items. tagging dmitri and sam.

incbot: Incident SEV2 -> transitioned to mitigated at 4312345900. Please file postmortem within 72h.
